targets.evidence_quote: The study is a replication of the study by Thaler-Kall and colleagues from 2014, who studied the association between anemia and self-reported falls among 967 women and men 65 years and older in the KORA-Age study from 2009.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The main null association agrees with the original, as stated in the discussion opening and conclusion. However the authors explicitly report that the original joint effect of anemia and disability was not supported. The main-finding confirmation is not an overall verdict covering all tested findings, so the explicit contrast makes the outcome mixed.
